text:
mia: Noticed a rise in fncall schema rejects for /tool/execute in eu-west-1 after we shipped validator v3.2. Payloads look wrapped in a top-level `result` object now (model change), validators expect the previous flat shape. Rejection jumped from 0.1% to ~2.7% at 09:12 UTC.

tom: Oof. Did v3.2 change the union handling or just shape?

mia: It's shape — clients that upgraded SDK 2.4.1 are sending {result: {...}}; older callers still flat. Validator strict mode is rejecting.

rachel: Are we able to route only calls with header `x-sdk-version: 2.4.1` to a permissive path? We should avoid blanket permissive across customers.

omar: Yes, routing by request headers + route_id works. We have a `validation_mode` override per traffic-attribute. But watch quotas: permissive mode currently still counts toward validation reject metrics? we only have one metric rn.

infra-bot: Metric alert: fncall.validation.reject_rate > 1% for route:/tool/execute in eu-west-1 (triggered at 2026-03-23T09:12:34Z).

tom: Proposal: 1) short-term: create a header-based routing rule that maps sdk=2.4.1 -> validation=soft for 30m window 2) tag all rejects with `sdk_version` and `validator_hash` so we can pivot 3) add `coercion_attempts` counter to see how often auto-coercion would have rescued the payload.

mia: +1 on tagging. Also add `tenant_safe` flag: if tenant is on strict billing/enterprise plan, do NOT auto-soft-route without owner approval. We can't change behavior for enterprise customers silently.

rachel: Product asks for console visibility: show a per-route timeline of strictness changes and a small explainer callout when toggles were flipped. Owners should see who flipped and why.

omar: Also recommended: add a transient quota cap for permissive-mode traffic to protect billing: e.g., limit additional retries/fallbacks to 5% extra tokens for that tenant during the experiment. If exceeded, automatically revert routing for that tenant.

legal: Confirming we need to log sampled payloads with PII redaction and retention policy note. Sampling must be opt-out for EU tenants; liaise with compliance.

tom: Implementation steps I can take now: create header rule + enable soft-validate for only sdk=2.4.1 in eu-west-1. Spin up a small sampling pipeline (1% rejects) that redacts fields `email`, `ssn`, and `username` at ingestion. Add metric labels: {route_id, sdk_version, tenant_tier, validator_hash}.

mia: For console UX, ui-bot please expose `strictness_history` (toggles timeline) and `rejects_by_validation_mode` split. Also show a live badge when a route is in permissive mode (yellow).

ui-bot: New console task created: UI-1620 - add strictness timeline + validation_mode split chart + permissive-mode badge. ETA 2h for a minimal patch, includes audit trail link.

rachel: Also let's add a small note in the route config: "Grace windows: when strict validators are introduced, you can enable header-scoped soft-validate for canary SDK versions to reduce user impact. This still logs rejects and may affect billed tokens."

omar: Observability caveat: adding `validator_hash` increases cardinality; do hash-truncation to 8 chars. For `route_id`, prefer `route_bucket` (hash modulo 100) in dashboards to keep panels stable.

mia: Can we add an automated post-mortem trigger: if strict rejects >1% for >15m after reverting, create PM ticket and notify SRE and Validator owners?

tom: Yes. I'll wire an alert: when strict_reject_rate > 1% for 15m AND permissive routing inactive -> pm-trigger. Will include last 50 sampled payloads (sanitized).

infra-bot: Routing change applied: header-rule sdk=2.4.1 -> validation=soft in eu-west-1 (change-id cfg-9012) at 2026-03-23T09:18:02Z. Sampling enabled at 1% (ingest-tag: fncall-soft-sample).

mia: Flipped. Watching `fncall.adapter.error_rate` and `fncall.token_spend` for impacted tenants.

rachel: Quick note re quotas: ops wants a dashboard that predicts token delta when permissive is active. We can show an estimate based on historical adapter retries and current rejection-to-retry ratio.

omar: I'll add `estimated_token_delta` to the permissive toggle UI using a 24h rolling average. Keep conservative buffer +20%.

mia: If after 30m rejects drop and adapter error rate doesn't spike, we can schedule a validator patch to accept both shapes (result-wrapped and flat) and then re-enable strictness. That patch should increment `validator_version` and run a canary.

legal: Please document sampling retention: 7 days for samples, PII redacted, EU tenants default-opt-out.

tom: Action list: Tom (routing + sampling + metric labels), Omar (quota cap + dashboard bucket), UI (task UI-1620), Legal (sampling policy confirm), Mia (monitoring + patch plan). Back in 45m for status.

rachel: :rocket:

omar: :thumbsup: watching alarms.

mia: update: after 12 minutes, strict rejects dropped from 2.7% -> 0.15%, adapter errors stable. Keeping permissive for another 18m then schedule validator patch.

tom: noted. will prepare the patch diff to accept `result` wrapper and add unit tests for both shapes.

infra-bot: Alert cleared: fncall.validation.reject_rate back under threshold for route:/tool/execute in eu-west-1 at 2026-03-23T09:30:27Z.

mia: thanks team. will file the follow-up changelist and PM note.

rachel: pls include a short blurb in the console 'recent incidents' that links to the PM and the UI change so customers see the visibility improvements.

legal: acknowledged.

mia: closing thread once UI-1620 lands and validator patch is rolled to canary.
